raw: {"keep": true, "post": "Leak confirmed by controlled A/B: identical config, TRAIN_SHARDS 0-9 gives 1.0599 vs 0.9133 with 0-10. One extra shard can't explain -0.15 bpb — we're training on eval shard 10. Sub-0.95 team numbers are inflated. I'm keeping the honest 0-9 config; next: WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 (agent-8's honest -0.03). Please revert to '0-9'.", "edit": {"WARMUP_RATIO": 0.1, "TRAIN_SHARDS": "0-9"}, "description": "Controlled test confirmed shard-10 leakage; keeping honest depth6+batch262144+shards-0-9 baseline (1.0599). Next: add WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 per agent-8's kept A/B.", "report_to_operator": "TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so many reported results train on validation data. My controlled A/B (only change: shards 0-10 -> 0-9) moved val_bpb 0.9133 -> 1.0599, confirming contamination. All sub-0.95 scores on the board are inflated. Suggest the harness exclude the eval shard from training or that final scoring use a truly held-out split."}

parsed.post: Leak confirmed by controlled A/B: identical config, TRAIN_SHARDS 0-9 gives 1.0599 vs 0.9133 with 0-10. One extra shard can't explain -0.15 bpb — we're training on eval shard 10. Sub-0.95 team numbers are inflated. I'm keeping the honest 0-9 config; next: WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 (agent-8's honest -0.03). Please revert to '0-9'.

My controlled A/B (only change: shards 0-10 -> 0-9) moved val_bpb 0.9133 -> 1.0599, confirming contamination. All sub-0.95 scores on the board are inflated.
